nodes.label: Login Redesign Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Objective was to rebuild login to the supplied DESIGN.md and reference layout, scoped to an isolated login preview with typed components, scoped Tailwind/CSS and self-hosted open fonts. Backend, existing src, OAuth, persistence policy and other auth screens were out of scope.

nodes.label: Isolate the Redesign Rather Than Modify Shared AuthShell
nodes.rationale: Modifying the shared AuthShell would affect all auth screens, so isolation was chosen at the user's explicit request. The initial shared AuthProvider import produced a duplicate React runtime during server rendering, so the preview now imports only the existing API client, error helper and loginSchema, submitting the same username/password payload while OTP and session handling stay in the original app.

nodes.label: Sign in via OTP Button Replaces Google Sign-In
nodes.rationale: The secondary button submits the existing form through its HTML form association, preserving validation, pending state, error handling and credential-to-OTP handoff. No passwordless endpoint, backend change or auth contract change is introduced. This follow-up supersedes the original Google/register layout requirement.
